tasks.label: Generate .env.template
args: const fs = require("fs"); const envPath = "Backend/.env"; const templatePath = "Backend/.env.template"; if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) { const template = fs.readFileSync(envPath, "utf8").split("\n").map(line => { if (line.trim().startsWith("#") || !line.includes("=")) return line; const [key] = line.split("="); return `${key}=`; }).join("\n"); fs.writeFileSync(templatePath, template); console.log(".env.template generated successfully!"); } else { console.error("Error: Backend/.env file not found."); process.exit(1); }
